controles.verbatim_source: Siemens Report FY2025 : "On November 12, 2025, Siemens announced its intention to deconsolidate Siemens Healthineers by transferring 30% of Siemens Healthineers shares to Siemens AG shareholders by way of a direct spin-off as preferable option.
